messages:
Priya: Quick sync — migration milestones for the /v2 cutover. Proposed schedule: staged rollout over 4 weeks starting 2024-02-20. Owners: Marco (infra), Alice (SDK), Ben (routing). Any blockers?
Marco: 👍 infra needs the proxy header change merged (PR: https://git.redwood/example/pr/2345). ETA Fri.
Alice: SDK change is ready, waiting on the top-level build dep bump. I can cut an RC Monday once the bump lands.
Ben: Routing needs a canary flag and traffic slices. Suggest windows: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over three days each. @eng-oncall to confirm.
Carmen: Oncall windows look OK. We need a clear fallback policy — what do we return when v2 404s or errors during rollout?
Priya: Fallback = v1 passthrough for the first two slices, then hardened fallback (canned reply) if errors persist. Deprecation announcement planned for 2024-03-25. See checklist: https://confluence.redwood/migration-checklist
Alice: Quick SDK note — we should surface an opt-in feature flag `compat_passthrough` so clients can toggle behavior without redeploying.
Marco: Can confirm proxy will add the SDK header. Example snippet added to proxy: `proxy.headers.add("X-Redwood-SDK", request.sdk_version)`
Ben: Routing PR ready for review: https://git.redwood/example/pr/2399 — needs one infra and one sdk review before I can flip the flag.
Priya: Ping @Alice @Marco for reviews. Also assigning checklist owners in the doc.
deploy-bot: Deploy started for staging/v2 at 2024-02-12T16:00Z :rocket:
Alice: Staging smoke passed. Noticed a cache key mismatch for conversation sync — filing bug #452, marking as blocker for full slice.
Marco: Infra will be doing a gradual kernel upgrade next week which may affect tail latency. Planning to opt-out the v2 nodes for initial 1% canary.
Carmen: Agree we need the SDK toggle plus an oncall runbook step: rollback via routing flag + SDK passthrough. I'll update runbook.
Alice: Added `compat_passthrough=true` to the RC config and updated SDK docs with the sample header.
Priya: Next steps: Marco finish proxy PR by Fri, Alice cut RC Monday, Ben get routing reviews, Carmen update oncall runbook. Reconvene Friday to confirm dates. Thanks all.
Ben: ACK, reviewing PRs today.
Alice: ack
Marco: ack
Carmen: ack
